facts.value: Turn your understanding of language into the ability to shape how meaning works in the world. In the online Bachelor of Arts in English from Arizona State University, you’ll learn to analyze, interpret and direct how language creates impact across contexts, from human communication to AI tools that rely on language to function. You’ll graduate with the ability to evaluate complex ideas, construct narratives and guide how messages are understood across audiences, platforms and technologies. As AI becomes more integrated into how content is produced and consumed, these skills can help you build the capacity to use and refine how language performs.
